outcomes.question: Bears vs. Packers: 3Q O/U 7.5

raw_market.question: Bears vs. Packers: 3Q O/U 7.5
raw_market.description:
In the third quarter of the NFL game between Bears and Packers, scheduled for October 11 at 4:25 PM ET:

This market will resolve to "Over" if the Bears and Packers combine to score 8 or more points in the third quarter.

If the combined third quarter total is less than 8, this market will resolve to "Under".

Only points scored during that period count; overtime is not included.

If the game is postponed, this market will remain open until the game has been completed. If the game is canceled entirely, with no make-up game, this market will resolve 50-50.
